SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current) AS current_rows,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member) AS distinct_members,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current) AS distinct_current,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE valid_to='9999-12-31' AND NOT is_current) AS open_not_current,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND valid_to<>'9999-12-31') AS current_closed,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE valid_to='9999-12-31') AS open_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE valid_to='9999-12-31' AND tier='Gold') AS open_gold,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE current_date BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to AND tier='Gold') AS gold_today,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates) AS stg_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE tier IS NULL OR tier NOT IN ('Basic','Silver','Gold')) AS odd_tier

calls.statement: SELECT tier, is_current, count(*), count(DISTINCT member_id), min(valid_from), max(valid_from), min(valid_to), max(valid_to), (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates s JOIN dim_member d USING (member_key)) AS key_overlap_with_dim FROM stg_member_updates GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) AS stg_rows, sum(CASE WHEN d.member_id=s.member_id AND d.tier=s.tier AND d.is_current=s.is_current AND d.valid_from=s.valid_from AND d.valid_to=s.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS identical,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE tier='Gold' AND is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_gold
FROM stg_member_updates s JOIN dim_member d USING (member_key)

SELECT count(*) AS gold_current, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS gold_members, sum(CASE WHEN join_date > DATE '2026-10-08' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS future_join, sum(CASE WHEN valid_from > DATE '2026-10-08' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS future_version, min(member_id), max(member_id), min(join_date), max(join_date)
FROM dim_member WHERE tier='Gold' AND is_current
